lead.event: Authorities advance the investigation into suspected Dian Swastatika Sentosa share manipulation
lead.headline: Authorities advance DSSA manipulation probe, estimate losses at Rp16 trillion
lead.blurb: Investigators say three people allegedly inflated Dian Swastika Sentosa shares through organized fictitious trading from 2023 to 2025, then sold at high levels. PPATK and OJK jointly estimated losses at approximately Rp16 trillion, and PPATK will submit its analysis of securities accounts suspected of receiving proceeds from capital-market crimes to Bareskrim. DSSA fell 6.72% to Rp555 in the first trading session, while management said the case had no material impact on its financial condition or operations.

deals_control.event: Unilever Indonesia agrees to sell its food business to McCormick
deals_control.headline: UNVR agrees to sell food business to McCormick for Rp20.5 trillion
deals_control.blurb: The sale includes the food business’s operations, factory assets, intellectual property, contracts and employees, but excludes Buavita, Lipton Ready-to-Drink and Unilever-branded trademarks and domains. Unilever Indonesia expects cash and equivalents to rise to around Rp24.04 trillion. Shareholders will consider the deal at an EGM on 29 January 2027, with eligibility set by the 18 December 2026 record date.

deals_control.event: DMS Propertindo shareholders approve a rights issue to fund acquisitions
deals_control.headline: KOTA shareholders approve rights issue of up to 100 billion shares
deals_control.blurb: The planned acquisitions are worth around Rp4.4 trillion. KOTA plans to buy 99.99% of Art Design Indonesia for around Rp1.2 trillion and 99.99% of Mandirinusa Graha Perkasa for around Rp3.2 trillion, adding about 572.28 hectares to its land bank.

deals_control.event: Danantara merges BRINS and Jasaraharja Putera into Jasindo
deals_control.headline: BBRI says Danantara plans BRINS-JRP merger into Jasindo with 809,195 new shares
deals_control.blurb: BRINS’ and Jasaraharja Putera’s sharia business units are excluded and must be separated or transferred before 31 December 2026. Jasindo will survive the merger, which is projected to take effect on 1 January 2027.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: BRINS’ and JRP’s sharia business units are excluded from the merger and must be separated or transferred before 31 December 2026.

market_structure_policy.event: Danantara proceeds with mergers of six state construction companies into three
market_structure_policy.headline: Danantara proceeds with merging six state builders into three
market_structure_policy.blurb: Danantara will finalize the Nindya Karya–Brantas Abipraya merger this year, followed by combining Adhi Karya and PP, whose restructuring is complete. The Waskita Karya–Wijaya Karya merger is postponed to early next year because both companies face deep financial problems requiring restructuring.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX suspends five companies over inaccurate free-float disclosures
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX suspends AKKU, BAJA, FIRE, KING and KPIG over inaccurate free-float disclosures
market_structure_policy.blurb: Anugerah Kagum Karya Utama, Saranacentral Bajatama, Alfa Energi Investama, Hoffmen Cleanindo and MNC Tourism Indonesia had inconsistencies in September share-registration reports compared with KSEI ownership data for shareholders holding above 1%. Trading in their regular and cash markets has been suspended from 27 November until further notice after the companies failed to clarify or correct the reports by 26 November.

market_structure_policy.event: MSCI's November review removes Barito Pacific from Global Standard and downgrades Bumi Resources Minerals
market_structure_policy.headline: MSCI removes BRPT, downgrades BRMS; Maybank sees up to Rp1.2 trillion in outflows
market_structure_policy.blurb: Barito Pacific shares rose 8.22% to Rp790 by the end of the first trading session on 27 November. Maybank estimates passive outflows of Rp0.7 trillion to Rp1.2 trillion and says BRPT will not enter Small Cap. Funds tracking the indexes rebalance after the exchange closes on 30 November, with the new composition effective 1 December.

other.event: Bank Central Asia declares its third interim dividend for fiscal 2026
other.headline: BBCA declares third fiscal 2026 interim dividend of Rp35 per share
other.blurb: The Rp4.29 trillion distribution carries a 1 December record date and payment on 16 December. It is the final interim payout for 2026, taking cumulative interim dividends to Rp80 per share. BCA shares rose 1.29% to Rp5,900 on 26 November, implying an interim dividend yield of about 0.59%.

other.event: TBS Energi Utama shares surge in trading
other.headline: TOBA shares surge 24.85% to Rp412
other.blurb: TBS Energi Utama briefly rose 10.68% to Rp456 at the 27 November opening, making it a top gainer in KOMPAS100. For the first nine months of 2026, revenue fell 11% to Rp4.63 trillion, while its consolidated net loss narrowed 72% to Rp637.2 billion.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: TBS Energi Utama shareholders approve HPS investment for waste-management expansion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TOBA shareholders approve HPS investment of up to S$555 million
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Funds and accounts managed by HPS Investment Partners, part of BlackRock, plan to invest through newly issued preferred shares and other instruments in SBTH Asia Holdings, the parent of TBS Energi Utama’s waste-management operations. The investment exceeds 50% of TBS Energi Utama’s equity and will fund its waste-management expansion in Asia.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Allo Bank completes most of its share-buyback program
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBHI completes most of its buyback after spending Rp293.17 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Allo Bank has repurchased 274 million shares, including 12.56 million at an average Rp620 each on 27 November. The Rp300 billion program, funded from retained earnings, runs through 2 December, with Mandiri Sekuritas as executing exchange member.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Eagle High Plantations plans a bond and sukuk issuance
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BWPT plans Rp550 billion bond and sukuk issuance
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Eagle High Plantations plans bonds of up to Rp175 billion and sukuk of up to Rp375 billion. Bond proceeds will repay Rp102.67 billion of bank loan principal and fund working capital, while sukuk proceeds will fund working capital. The instruments are scheduled to list on 3 December.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Andalan Artha Primanusa targets mining expansion ahead of its IPO
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Andalan Artha Primanusa targets mining expansion ahead of its Rp316.76 billion IPO
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The mining contractor has entered nickel mining services and is exploring bauxite and gold, aiming to become one of Indonesia’s top five mining contractors. Its IPO offers up to 1.68 billion shares, equal to 25.10% of paid-in capital, with 65% of proceeds earmarked for working capital and 35% for debt repayment.

earnings_guidance.headline: KRAS reports US$6.31 million consolidated profit in first half of 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Revenue rose 36.5% to US$609.21 million from US$446.45 million a year earlier. Profit attributable to owners of the parent was US$655,000, reversing a US$107.12 million loss.

earnings_guidance.event: Barito Pacific reports third-quarter results and advances its diversification strategy
earnings_guidance.headline: BRPT reports Q3 revenue up 56.3% as it advances diversification
earnings_guidance.blurb: Barito Pacific reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of USD8.69 billion, up 56.3% year on year, and EBITDA of around USD1.4 billion. It plans to acquire automotive business Cycle & Carriage to complement its Esso fuel station retail network.

earnings_guidance.event: United Tractors reports lower Komatsu heavy-equipment sales through October
earnings_guidance.headline: UNTR reports Komatsu heavy-equipment sales down 16.85% to 3,325 units
earnings_guidance.blurb: United Tractors' mining-sector sales fell 36% to 1,560 units, while agribusiness and construction sales rose 34% and 19%. Phintraco Sekuritas analyst Alrich Paskalis Tambolang expects a gradual recovery in 2027, depending on coal quotas and commodity prices, and recommends gradual share accumulation pending confirmation of operational recovery.

earnings_guidance.event: Bumi Resources reports a sharp increase in profit through September 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: BUMI reports nine-month profit up 404.9% to US$148.47 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas assigned an Accumulative Buy rating with a target price of Rp222 per share. Nine-month revenue rose 38.85% to US$1.44 billion, while profit for the period increased 190.45% to US$174.56 million.
